spans.s:
हैतुक हैतुक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. हेतु), causal,
causative; argumentative, rationalistic; (अस्), m. a
reasoner, arguer, logical reasoner; a follower of the
Mīmāṃsā doctrines; one who requires a reason for
everything, a rationalist, sceptic, causalist, sophist,
heretic.

हैतुक्य, अम्, n. causality, causativeness, (अ-है-
तुक्य, अम्, n. absence of interested motives.)
